summary_en: Kakaku.com board of directors reversed prior recommendation to shareholders to tender shares in Kamgras 1 K.K. tender offer; board now takes neutral stance while maintaining support for the transaction. Tender price and other material terms unchanged from prior May 12, 2026 announcement. Delisting intended upon completion.
title_en: Notice of Revision to 'Notice of Expression of Opinion Supporting and Recommendation to Tender in Response to the Public Tender Offer for Kakaku.com Shares by Kamgras 1 K.K.'
translation_en_brief: On July 2, 2026, Kakaku.com filed a revision notice to its prior May 12, 2026 announcement regarding the public tender offer for its shares by Kamgras 1 K.K. (an acquisition vehicle). The board had initially recommended that shareholders tender on May 12, 2026. However, following receipt of a legally binding proposal from Kamgras 1 on July 1, 2026, the board held a meeting on July 1, 2026 and reversed its prior recommendation. The board now takes a neutral stance, leaving the tender decision entirely to shareholders and warrant holders; the board maintains its view that the transaction itself is appropriate and that it will result in delisting and going-private of Kakaku.com. The tender price, share count, and other commercial terms remain as announced in the prior disclosure; this notice reports only the change in board stance from 'recommend' to 'neutral'.
